forms.name: Greek Small Letter Lamda
forms.meaning: Ecliptic longitude in the labelled example; ordinary Greek lambda elsewhere.
forms.drawing: <g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="60" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M135 200 C215 150 250 245 285 330 L545 810 M340 430 L115 810"/></g>
forms.note: Curved ascender and two diverging feet; does not reuse Latin l or capital A.

forms.name: Greek Small Letter Beta
forms.meaning: Ecliptic latitude in the labelled example; ordinary Greek beta elsewhere.
forms.drawing: <g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="60" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M115 920 V365 C115 140 500 145 500 345 C500 450 405 500 285 500 H115 M285 500 C590 500 590 810 310 810 C220 810 155 775 115 730"/></g>
forms.note: Rounded upper entry, two open counters and a clear descender distinguish beta from Latin B and b.

forms.name: Greek Small Letter Delta
forms.meaning: Declination in the labelled example; ordinary Greek delta elsewhere.
forms.drawing: <g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="60" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M475 205 C340 130 180 180 235 290 C275 370 430 400 495 535 C600 750 380 875 205 785 C40 695 100 475 270 430 C345 410 435 435 495 535"/></g>
forms.note: Loop below a curling upper stroke; no straight Latin d ascender.

forms.name: Greek Small Letter Alpha
forms.meaning: Right ascension in the labelled example; ordinary Greek alpha elsewhere.
forms.drawing: <g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="60" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M555 420 C485 625 410 815 255 815 C45 815 55 415 270 415 C420 415 450 625 515 750 Q550 820 620 790"/></g>
forms.note: Crossing right arm and open exit make a Greek alpha rather than a copy of Latin a.

forms.name: Greek Small Letter Phi
forms.meaning: Observer latitude in the labelled example; ordinary Greek phi elsewhere.
forms.drawing: <g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="60" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M210 420 C75 420 85 755 280 800 C440 845 625 725 600 565 C580 425 420 370 360 480 C315 560 350 720 365 920"/></g>
forms.note: Loopy small-letter form with a descending return. Reserves straight phi U+03D5 as a separate possible future character.

forms.name: Greek Small Letter Epsilon
forms.meaning: Obliquity in the labelled example; ordinary Greek epsilon elsewhere.
forms.drawing: <g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="60" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M480 455 C335 340 100 405 120 540 C130 605 205 620 330 610 M330 610 C160 590 80 680 150 765 C230 865 405 820 495 755"/></g>
forms.note: Two open lobes and a short middle arm; distinct from Latin e and the dedicated lunate epsilon symbol.

forms.name: Superscript Zero
forms.meaning: Raised digit zero for literal plain-text indices or powers.
forms.drawing: <g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="58" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><ellipse cx="150" cy="300" rx="95" ry="140"/></g>
forms.note: Unslashed oval default, matching the ordinary zero decision. No slashed superscript alternate proposed.

forms.name: Superscript One
forms.meaning: Raised digit one; fills the original inventory omission.
forms.drawing: <g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="58" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M75 230 L150 160 V440 M65 440 H235"/></g>
forms.note: Angled flag and full foot keep one distinct from an apostrophe or lowercase l.

forms.name: Superscript Five
forms.meaning: Raised digit five for literal plain-text indices or powers.
forms.drawing: <g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="58" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M240 160 H65 V290 C145 235 250 270 250 365 C250 460 115 480 55 415"/></g>
forms.note: Broad top and open neck; optical drawing at the existing superscript weight.

forms.name: Superscript Six
forms.meaning: Raised digit six for literal plain-text indices or powers.
forms.drawing: <g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="58" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M230 190 C160 115 65 210 50 315 C25 435 54 445 150 445 C285 450 290 310 170 310 C100 310 55 365 55 400"/></g>
forms.note: Open upper hook and enlarged lower counter; preserves a gap at the hook.

forms.name: Superscript Seven
forms.meaning: Raised digit seven for literal plain-text indices or powers.
forms.drawing: <g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="58" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M50 160 H250 L105 440"/></g>
forms.note: Simple unbarred seven, consistent with the approved ordinary digit.

forms.name: Superscript Eight
forms.meaning: Raised digit eight for literal plain-text indices or powers.
forms.drawing: <g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="58" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M150 300 C40 290 55 160 150 160 C245 160 260 290 150 300 C253 305 270 445 150 445 C30 445 35 305 150 300 Z"/></g>
forms.note: Two counters and a fuller lower bowl; avoids a mechanically scaled thin stroke.

forms.name: Superscript Nine
forms.meaning: Raised digit nine for literal plain-text indices or powers.
forms.drawing: <g transform="rotate(180 150 300)"><g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="58" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M230 190 C160 115 65 210 50 315 C25 435 54 445 150 445 C285 450 290 310 170 310 C100 310 55 365 55 400"/></g></g>
forms.note: Rotated companion of six, matching the earlier numeral-family construction.

forms.name: Apostrophe
forms.meaning: Literal ASCII apostrophe / single quote; context determines its text use.
forms.drawing: <g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="60" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M110 190 V375"/></g>
forms.note: Vertical straight mark. Existing slanted prime U+2032 is retained separately for arcminutes.

forms.name: Quotation Mark
forms.drawing: <g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="60" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M110 190 V375 M250 190 V375"/></g>
forms.note: Two vertical straight marks. Existing slanted double prime U+2033 is retained separately for arcseconds.
